{{Top|leg}}
The '''House of Citizens''' was the planetary government that ruled [[Corulag/Legends|Corulag]]. It was elected by the populace and during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] period presided over by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Zafiel Snopps]].

There were a number of political parties that were represented in the House of Citizens but all were firmly loyal to the Empire.
